claim_ceiling: This registry identifies source references and license-review state. It contains no MineLib data, block models, scheduling results, or copied third-party datasets.

entries.title: MineLib open-pit mining optimization benchmark instances
entries.citation: MineLib dataset catalogue; accessed as a reference record for MINE-REFERENCE-001.
entries.review_note: Review instance-specific academic-download terms before retrieval, caching, derived redistribution, or committing data. Do not treat public listing as permission to redistribute.

entries.title: MineLib file format specification v1.0
entries.citation: Espinoza, Goycoolea, Moreno and Newman, MineLib file format specification v1.0, 2012-07-23.
entries.review_note: Reference only. The format document describes linked block-model, precedence, and problem-data files. Validate exact fields and terms against the complete upstream specification before implementing a parser.

entries.title: An open-source optimization model for sustainable open-pit mine production scheduling
entries.citation: Lotsu, Bimpong and Boakye, Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence 9 (2026), 1759758.
entries.review_note: The paper evaluates a 602-block, 12-period synthetic case and documents a Zenodo artifact record. Its modeled NPV and runtime are not real-mine performance claims; inspect the separate data-artifact license before using or redistributing artifact files.

entries.title: Artifacts for the open-source sustainable open-pit production-scheduling study
entries.citation: Data and code artifact record cited by Lotsu, Bimpong and Boakye (2026).
entries.upstream_version: record version not verified in this registry
entries.review_note: The article says the artifact contains a synthetic block model, notebooks, outputs, and MineLib-format loaders. The license of this separate artifact record has not been independently verified here. Do not cache or redistribute until reviewed.

entries.title: The Value of Drilling—A Chance-Constrained Optimization Approach
entries.citation: Jeuken and Forbes, Mining, Metallurgy & Exploration 41 (2024), 2279–2289.
entries.review_note: Research motivation for chance-constrained blending and value of additional information. The paper is not itself a license for any underlying mine dataset; no study data is bundled. The license was not independently verified in this registry; link only, no copied text or data.

entries.title: Integrated Stochastic Underground Mine Planning with Long-Term Stockpiling
